{{Quote|Our biggest, most stacked slider! Piled high with two patties, triple cheese, deep-fried Tapani triangles, mega-leaf lettuce, a slice of algae-bread, Boontaspiced mustard, plankton spread, larded neutrinos and a fried blubberbird egg, with a green jumbolive on top, it's just the thing to satisfy a Herglic-sized hunger.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Giju slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
A '''larded neutrino''' was a type of [[Foodstuff|food]] used as an ingredient by the [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] to make the [[giju slider]]s he sold at his [[Dex's Diner/Legends|diner]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[slider]] was created by Jettster and was inspired<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> by the planet [[Giju/Legends|Giju]].<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Larded neutrinos was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
